nina_marketing: Quick thread — we need two X + one LinkedIn carousel for the webinar push. Assets + UTMs by 5pm PT so Tara can queue across NA/EU/APAC.

mike_content: I'll drop DataVariant and StoryVariant copy plus a 9:16 clip and square hero. Draft UTMs: ?utm_source=platform&utm_campaign=webinar_q2&utm_medium=social&utm_bucket=data|story

tara_social: Preference: X short CTA 'save your spot' and LI carousel with 4 cards. Will pin X for 48h. Need final links with UTMs injected to scheduler.

kevin_growth: Routing rules: traffic_bucket=data -> queue bench-sdr; story -> queue narrative-sdr. Add field `orig_channel=social` in webhook. High-intent = clicked >2 times or watched >30s.

olivia_ops: I'll spin a staging webhook consumer to map `utm_bucket` to CRM property `social_bucket` and run an end-to-end test during the first post.

legal_bot: Quick note: avoid explicit numeric claims unless you attach the benchmark PDF. 'Notable performance improvements' is fine.

mike_content: Swapped numeric language for 'notable performance improvements' and uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar/q2/178765

scheduler_bot: Drafts created: x_data_178765, x_story_178765, li_carousel_178765. Preview: https://scheduler.internal/drafts/178765

tara_social: I'll queue drafts when legal gives final ok. If approved I'll post NA morning, EU afternoon, APAC evening.

nina_marketing: Good cadence. Final checklist: assets in drive (mike), UTMs added (mike + nina), scheduler drafts (tara + scheduler_bot), CRM routing (kevin + olivia), legal sign-off. Closing here once scheduled. :rocket:
